newsitem.title: USA: Sunglass Hut says sales continue sluggish.
newsitem.headline: Sunglass Hut says sales continue sluggish.

text.p: Sunglass Hut said Friday that overall comparable store and new store sales were continuing "sluggish consistent with April's trends."
The company reports May sales June 5.
In a statement Sunglass Hut said it is encouraged by the sell-through of new products.
The company also said inventory levels continue to be reduced consistent with plan.
Last week Sunglass Hut said first-quarter net fell to $0.01 per share, or $292,000, from $0.13 a share or $7.2 million a year earlier. April same-store sales fell 3.3 percent.
The company said in a statement that overall comparable-store and new-store sales were continuing "sluggish, consistent with April's trends." It reports May sales June 5.

"As Sunglass Hut has grown and evolved, the challenges the company faces have changed," said Hauslein. "Our strategic focus is to enhance the profitability of our existing base of stores through new marketing programs and improved store-level execution, pursue selected further unit expansion in North America and further refine Sunglass Hut's international opportunities."
Hauslein also said the company planned to further develop the "Watch Station concept."
